{{Lunisolar August}} 
'''August 3''' is the 3rd day of month {{ill|August (Lunisolar)|ja|8月 (旧暦)|lt=August (Hazuki)}}  the 8th month of the traditional {{ill|Japanese Lunisolar Calendar|ja|旧暦}} . It's {{ill|Rokuyō|ja|六曜}}  day is {{ill|Butsumetsu|ja|仏滅|zh|佛滅日|qid=Q10886789}} .
